fun_facts: Josh Downs is from Suwanee, Georgia.
Josh Downs earned All-ACC honors twice at North Carolina.
Josh Downs had more than 1,000 receiving yards in each of two back-to-back seasons at North Carolina.
Josh Downs caught 22 career touchdown passes in three seasons at North Carolina.
Josh Downs set a Colts rookie record with 68 catches in his first NFL season.

excerpts:
* [Print](https://www.espn.com/espn/print?id=35217811)

Two-time All-ACC wide receiver [Josh Downs](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4688813/josh-downs) is leaving North Carolina for the NFL, he told ESPN.

Downs is the No. 4-rated wide receiver in the upcoming draft, according to ESPN NFL draft analyst Todd McShay , making him one of the top receiving prospects available for NFL teams.

Downs had back-to-back seasons of more than 1,000 yards receiving for the Tar Heels and caught 22 career touchdown passes. In just three seasons at UNC, he rose to No.
citations.title: Two-time All-ACC WR Josh Downs leaving North Carolina for NFL - ESPN

excerpts:
[Josh Downs](https://www.nfl.com/players/josh-downs) seems to have been somewhat lost in the equation.

The second-year receiver is coming off a campaign in which he set the club's rookie record with 68 catches, generating 771 yards and two touchdowns. Downs displayed a propensity to create open space on routes and clutch hands. His 3.3 yards of separation per target was equal to [Tyreek Hill](https://www.nfl.com/players/tyreek-hill) 's last season, per Next Gen Stats.

Downs aims to improve his route-running acumen even further, which would aid a Year 2 leap.
citations.title: Colts WR Josh Downs ready to make Year 2 leap: 'I left some plays on the field last year' | Latest NFL News, Analysis & Updates | NFL.com
